capabilities.notes: Existing dataset/provenance/HOLDOUT/promotion gates are preserved, but the native 397B total / 35B active target still requires candidate-bound training and independent evaluation evidence before completion can be claimed.
Read-only event/evidence integration starts in observe mode. Sentinel may interpret evidence but cannot mint Lang authority, Web3 decision signatures or new tool permissions.
An existing PQ watch/research line is surfaced to Fabric. Research, recommendation, test and live migration remain distinct; this is not a claim that supported networks have completed PQ migration.
